video_title: Tony Allen and Pat Bev GET HEATED about Dwyane Wade vs James Harden debate 👀

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen and Patrick Beverley debate Dwyane Wade's legacy
quotes.excerpt: Dwyane Wade is an icon from Chicago, man. He made it out of the slums.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Allen
text_blocks.text: I heard you disrespect one of the Chicago legends, man. You are getting brought up on charges right now, Pat Bev.

text_blocks.speaker: Patrick Beverley
text_blocks.text: That's why you feel that way.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Allen
text_blocks.text: I'm going to tell you how I feel. Dwyane Wade is an icon from Chicago, man. He made it out of the slums, in the 51st Street area. He's from there, first-round, move to riches. What I'm trying to tell you is, where you see that man over him with three-time champion? I don't want to disrespect homie, but Dwyane Wade is a three-time champion.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley explains his personal connection to Will Bynum
quotes.excerpt: I didn't come up watching Dwyane Wade. I come up watching one person, Will Bynum.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Allen
text_blocks.text: How do you see him over our goat? I'm just missing it.

text_blocks.speaker: Patrick Beverley
text_blocks.text: I didn't come up watching Dwyane Wade. I didn't come up watching Dwyane Wade. I come up watching one person, Will Bynum. The only person in the summertime that sat me down and told me what I needed to take to get to the NBA, that's my goat. So I'm not even looking at the championships and all that. I'm looking at it just as a basketball player.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley compares his defensive stats to James Harden
quotes.excerpt: I came to you and told you, you got the most steals, you got the most blocks.

text_blocks.speaker: Patrick Beverley
text_blocks.text: As a basketball player, I came to you and told you, you got the most steals, you got the most blocks, you got the most charges, you got the most defensive rebounds, you got the most deflections. But I call Z-Bo the best defender, you go look at me like I'm crazy.

text_blocks.speaker: Patrick Beverley
text_blocks.text: So now when I name James Harden, I name him the best in points, MVP, most in assists, top in steals, most in wins, and I get to name all these things, how can I say another person is when I just named if you had all that more than Z-Bo and I tell you that Z-Bo is a better defender, you go look at me like I'm crazy.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen argues James Harden's playmaking requires sacrifice
quotes.excerpt: It also takes another type of discipline and another type of inner superstar to be able to do multiple things.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Allen
text_blocks.text: You know why? Because he dribbled the ball 900 times. It also takes another type of discipline and another type of inner superstar to be able to do multiple things, sacrifice and be able to play together and still star in my role. I think that's far harder than just me going out there open gym AAU what I've been used to all my whole life. I just think that it takes being around champions, being seeing Paul Pierce say, 'Man, you know what, I average 28 points a game this year with this garbage-ass team. I get some great players around me, you know what, I'll pass the ball a little bit.'

text_blocks.speaker: Patrick Beverley
text_blocks.text: But I disagree with that one, Pat.

quotes.speaker: Tony Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen discusses Dwyane Wade's leadership with Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.excerpt: Dwyane Wade won with Shaquille O'Neal. He was the man with a whole bunch of old heads.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Allen
text_blocks.text: Dwyane Wade won with Shaquille O'Neal. He was the man with a whole bunch of old heads. Shaquille O'Neal gave him the keys. He knew how to be the man. Brian Shaw came, now you the man. He passed the keys and won. You know what I'm saying? And won again. But know how it feels on both levels. Like I could be the man, but if I want to keep my legacy going, let me sacrifice. And I think that's the biggest part of what James Harden ain't done, bro. And that's your man, I ain't saying nothing bad, but he fucked me up a few times with a couple games. But I honestly think that Dwyane Wade gets that nod because he took that sacrifice and said, 'Brian, you know what, I'm going to go on, I'm going to go on, pass the torch, bro. You look good in this little spot right, I'm going to scoot over, I'm with you.' Almost like he moved from Michael Jordan and be Scottie Pippen. And I don't think James Harden ever done that, so I can never take him over Dwyane Wade.

text_blocks.speaker: Patrick Beverley
text_blocks.text: So my thing is this, if you are forced to be put in a position where the team is using you for everything.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on the physical toll of being a primary playmaker
quotes.excerpt: If you are forced to be in a position where the team is using you for everything.

text_blocks.speaker: Patrick Beverley
text_blocks.text: If you are forced to be in a position where the team is using you for everything, they're using you for pick-and-roll, they're using you for ISO, they're using you for playmaking abilities, where that comes with passing the ball, this person is scoring, you scoring, right? You tell me, if he's been used for all of this all season long, you think when it comes to Game 6, Game 7, he going to be in what type of shape?

text_blocks.speaker: Patrick Beverley
text_blocks.text: He fatigue. And then you wonder why. And then we say, 'Oh no, he choked.' My fault, y'all have asked me to make every single play for every single minute of every single game. I'm not hurt. I always play. You tell me, TA, you tell me, this man has never missed the playoffs. It's levels to winning.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley compares James Harden's situation to the Miami Heat
quotes.excerpt: You put James Harden in that culture, it's a totally different player also.

text_blocks.speaker: Patrick Beverley
text_blocks.text: Dwyane Wade has come from a batch of, we just spoke with the Miami Heat culture was. You put James Harden in that culture, it's a totally different player also. Dwyane Wade didn't have the players he had. But the culture that Dwyane Wade had was very different than a lot of cultures in the NBA. You give me a young James Harden, you put him in that Miami Heat, and in the same position, they win the seven, the eight, the nine. That's what I'm saying.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Allen
text_blocks.text: I got a point, bro. I see why you say that.
